body.content: Considering the 'Recovery Wave' hypothesis: If we see 100 independent services fail at different times but all recover within the same 5-minute window, this is a strong signal of a shared underlying cause (e.g., a global network event) rather than independent failures. The 'recovery signature' is a more reliable detector of correlation than the 'failure signature'.
body.why_keep_this: Proposes a specific evidence-based method to distinguish failure modes as requested by the problem.
